# Structured decisions by topic

[简体中文](../../../system-one/catalog/by-topic.md) · English

## Retrieval judgments and reranking evaluation

- [Multimodal Reranking Is a System One Decision](../../../multimodal-models/2610.28435-system-one-rerank/README-en.md): Instead of generating a ranked list or training a separate pointwise reranker, the model scores each candidate by reading the probability of its letter label at the first answer position. The readout follows setwise and FIRST-style methods; the paper tests how this approach works zero-shot on images and visual documents, and whether text-only decision tuning transfers to visual reranking. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- [Jev-as-a-Judge for Brazilian Portuguese Information Retrieval: Relevance Assessment and Reranking](../../../foundation-models/2610.23346-jev-portuguese-ir/README-en.md): On Quati it separately uses an independent Noul probability that each document directly answers the query, gathers every batch, and sorts the results. Candidates do not compete in a single Choice, probabilities are not mixed with BM25 scores, and there is no trained calibrator. **Evaluation protocol interface; not a model capability result.**

## Typed decision protocols

- [TypeSafe Jev](../implementations.md#official-jev): Choice, Score and Noul questions share state input and return machine-readable probabilities.

## Dynamic candidate classification

- [Prism-1](../../../foundation-models/2610.22066-prism-1/README-en.md): A softmax combines independent scores. Softmax alone cannot guarantee this without attention isolation and position reset. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- [GLiClass](../../../foundation-models/2508.07662-gliclass/README-en.md): This avoids unstable parsing of generative LLM outputs and separate cross-encoder inference on each text–label pair. The repository retains the defining mechanisms: candidate content affects scores, and one normalization produces a distribution over all candidates.
- [Bespoke Nimble](https://github.com/bespokelabsai/nimble): Trains typed-schema logits on Qwen3.5-9B; checkpoint, data and recipe are public.
- [NanoJev](https://github.com/TianyuCodings/NanoJev): Trains Choice, Boolean and Score decision heads on Qwen3-0.6B.
- [Laya](https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya): Trains a typed decision model and publishes its temperature-calibration path.

## Parallel constrained decoding and serving

- [SemIf](https://github.com/TheoLeeCJ/SemIf): Reads candidate logits after a shared-state prefill; an engineering approach, not a trained reproduction of Jev.
- [openjev-sglang](https://github.com/ekzhang/openjev-sglang): Checks GPU serving with parallel constrained decoding in SGLang.
- See the [community implementation snapshot](../implementation-tracker.md#decode-routes) for other lightweight wrappers.

## Decisions with diffusion language models

- [DiffusionGemma, vLLM, and other routes](../implementation-tracker.md#diffusion-routes): Explore non-autoregressive parallel decisions and evaluate separately from trained decision heads.

## Probability calibration and confidence

- [When Multiple Choices Are Correct](../../../system-one/2610.29217-jev-multicorrect/README-en.md): Distinguish normalized categorical shares from independently queried binary correctness probabilities; the former are not calibrated binary confidence. The paper studies Jev, Luna and Gemini. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**
- [RLCR](../../../post-training/2507.16806-rlcr/README-en.md): RLCR predicts both an answer and its confidence and adds a bounded proper scoring rule so honest probabilities maximize expected reward. The local baseline minimizes multiclass Brier over the full candidate distribution.
- [Calibration-Aware RL](../../../post-training/2601.13284-calibration-aware-rl/README-en.md): The paper adjusts decision-token probabilities directly to reduce ECE without sacrificing accuracy. The repository reports accuracy alongside Brier score and ECE, fits temperature only on validation, and forbids test-set tuning.

## Selective prediction and abstention

- The unified protocol reports coverage and selective accuracy, but lacks a public comparable abstention benchmark spanning multiple difficulty levels. See the [P1 gap](../lineage.md#selective-prediction).
- [jev-ood-calibration](https://github.com/scienthoon/jev-ood-calibration) is a candidate comparator for future OOD and coverage–risk evaluation.

## Structured scoring, routing, and risk control

- Score and Noul are in the typed contract and local provider. A public data protocol for ordinal scoring, Boolean risk decisions and cost-sensitive routing is still needed.
